mechanism_criteria.assembly_scope: Two complete declared sites in a homodimer condition. PISA A2 is listed alongside author-assigned A4; this is not a claim that tetrameric assembly is dispensable.

metal_atp.basis: Each metal must contact a nonbridging phosphate oxygen of the same ATP. This is a minimal operational metal-nucleotide coupling test, not a calibrated complete reactant topology. Exact ADP-state alpha/beta patterns are diagnostic only; SO4 is not an exact ATP gamma atom reference.

mechanism_criteria.revision_note: Unified0.7.0 removes the general metal-distance lower gate by user request. Mechanism geometry and cutoffs are unchanged.
mechanism_criteria.aggregate: Both declared sites satisfy reaction axis, two-Mg organization and same-ATP proximity; general is reported independently.

site_assignment.basis: Protein-fitted analog anchors, not reaction distances or pass scores. No forced ligand/site occupancy.

source_stage_ownership_before_unificatio.stage_ownership: Mechanism: required site/partners and proximity upper limits. General: metal-O compression below 1.7 A. Signed reference deviations and legacy symmetric recovery remain diagnostics; compression is not a second mechanism veto.

site_reference.source: 1GSA A, ADP/GSH/SO4 analog-state reference; not reactant pose ground truth

metal_distance_diagnostic_policy.scope: All observed non-water protein and small-molecule oxygen atoms versus all declared Mg atoms. Dedicated coordination lower bound, not a sum-of-vdW-radii clash test.
metal_distance_diagnostic_policy.basis: Existing author operational 1.7 A bound transferred to general unchanged; not experimentally calibrated.
